title: Open-fMIND: A Large-Scale Open-Access fMRI Corpus for Pretraining Brain Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining has transformed language and vision, but its application to functional MRI (fMRI) is constrained by data access. The largest standardized fMRI resources are governed by data use agreements and dominated by a small number of acquisition protocols, while the thousands of openly licensed datasets on OpenNeuro are individually small, heterogeneously organized, and unprocessed. We present the first release of Open-fMIND, a uniformly preprocessed, openly accessible corpus of parcellated fMRI timeseries from 322 OpenNeuro studies, comprising 11,379 subjects and 45,731 functional runs. Each run is preprocessed with fMRIPrep and parcellated under 52 atlases spanning 14 families, yielding a massive 2.4 million timeseries. translated_title: Open-fMIND：用于预训练脑基础模型的大规模开放获取fMRI语料库
translated_abstract: 自监督预训练已经彻底改变了语言和视觉领域，但其在功能磁共振成像上的应用受到数据获取的限制。目前最大的标准化fMRI资源受数据使用协议约束，且被少数几种采集协议所主导；而OpenNeuro上数千个开放许可的数据集则各自规模较小、组织方式各异且未经处理。我们发布了Open-fMIND的首个版本，这是一个经过统一预处理、开放可获取的脑区划分fMRI时间序列语料库，涵盖322项OpenNeuro研究，包含11,379名被试和45,731次功能扫描。每次扫描均使用fMRIPrep进行预处理，并在涵盖14个家族的52种脑区图谱下进行划分，共产生240万条时间序列。这些时间序列以两种形式发布：一种是通过默认流程去噪后的版本，另一种是包含混杂文件协变量的fMRIPrep原始输出版本，同时提供功能连接矩阵、每次扫描的来源信息及元数据。
tldr: Open-fMIND是首个面向脑基础模型预训练的大规模开放获取fMRI语料库，对322项OpenNeuro研究的45,731次功能扫描进行了统一预处理，并以52种脑区图谱划分出240万条时间序列，解决了fMRI自监督预训练的数据获取瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Open-fMIND is the first large-scale open-access fMRI corpus for brain foundation model pretraining, uniformly preprocessing 45,731 functional runs from 322 OpenNeuro studies and parcellating them into 2.4 million timeseries under 52 atlases, addressing the data access bottleneck for self-supervised pretraining in fMRI.
